A PduRRoutingPath shall be enabled under either of the fol- lowing conditions: • if at least one PduRRoutingPathGroup is enabled it refers to • if the PduRRoutingPath does not reference any PduRRoutingPathGroup at all
A PduRRoutingPath shall be disabled, if all PduRRouting- PathGroup s it references are disabled.
All PduRRoutingPathGroup s where PduRIsEnabledA- tInit is set to TRUE shall be enabled after initialization of the PDU Router module.
All PduRRoutingPathGroup s where PduRIsEnabledA- tInit is set to FALSE shall be disabled.
If the routing path group exists and the routing path group is already disabled, then the PDU Router module shall return with no action.

If a PduRRoutingPathGroup is disabled by PduR_Dis- ableRouting , the PDU Router module shall re-evaluate all PduRRouting- Path s which are referencing the affected PduRRoutingPathGroup according to [SWS_PduR_00892].

If a PduRRoutingPathGroup is enabled by PduR_En- ableRouting , the PDU Router module shall re-evaluate all PduRRouting- Path s which are referencing the affected PduRRoutingPathGroup according to [SWS_PduR_00891].
If the routing path group exists and the routing path group is already enabled, then the PDU Router module shall return with no action.
The PDU Router module shall provide n:1 routing for I-PDUs received from multiple communication interface modules to one upper layer module.
The PDU Router module shall optionally support a reception FIFO in case of n:1 routing from multiple communication interface modules to one upper layer module.

If PduR_<User:Lo>RxIndication is called for a n:1 rout- ing point without a FIFO configured and the <Up>_RxIndication call of the most recent request has not returned, the PDU Router shall return immediately without call- ing <Up>_RxIndication and report PduR.PDUR_E_PDU_INSTANCES_LOST to the DET module.
